mathematical_result.statement: If an original-coordinate 2x2 principal block D is invertible indefinite, Delta=|det D|, kappa=sigma_min(D), and its physical Schur remainder S=C-B^T D^{-1}B is nonzero, then with eta(S) equal to the largest absolute diagonal entry when one exists and otherwise the largest absolute off-diagonal entry, the quadratic output has essential density height at most 2^(13/4)(Delta*kappa*eta(S))^(-1/4). For target matrices rank(A)>=3 makes S nonzero automatically. The designated account04/B15 same-constant closure then gives a C0 representative with the same height.
mathematical_result.new_small_ball: For every nonzero symmetric S and independent cap-one Z, sup_t P(|Z^T S Z+ell^T Z+c-t|<rho)<=2sqrt(2)sqrt(rho/eta(S)).
mathematical_result.definite_pair_companion: If D is definite, ||p_Q||_infinity<=pi/sqrt(|det D|), and in target rank>=3 the partner closure gives p_Q in C0 with the same bound.
mathematical_result.concrete_target: A(u,v)=[[0,2,u],[2,0,v],[u,v,2+uv]], |u|,|v|<=1/4, has three eigenvalue magnitudes >1.496 by Weyl and satisfies p_Q in C0 with ||p_Q||_infinity<=2^(9/4).
